doc: Thresholds for the eval feedback step (scripts/eval/lib/eval_feedback.py), as data. A rule fires when an eval's newest ok run has a metric matching `metric` (fnmatch) worse than `threshold` (`better` says which way is worse); per `critic` (rules without one share the eval's slot) the first firing rule raises one change on the worst such metric. `absent` is the value of a metric the next run lacks (a refusal class that stopped is 0). `change` is learning, routing, tool-ruling, prompt, cr-config or impacted-suites; `target` is the memory-inbox topic file, the route, the tool or the file the change edits.
